content: The DTCspecific Malfunction Indicator Lamp returned in the function Dem_J1939DcmGetNextDTCwithLampStatus shall be set to Lamp On in case the corresponding event has assigned the Indicator referenced by DemMILIndi- catorRef and the UDS status bit 7 (WarningIndicator) is active (set to 1), otherwise it shall be set to 'Lamp Off'.
